about_short_description.short_description: Topo.io is a B2B SaaS company that develops AI Agents for Outbound that work alongside your Sales team.

product.name: AI SDR Agents
product.description: AI-powered sales development representative agents that automate outbound lead generation, qualification, and outreach based on a defined outbound playbook.

product.name: AI-Powered Outbound Sales Platform
product.description: A platform that automates the entire outbound sales funnel including audience building, intent signal detection, lead qualification, data enrichment, messaging, and campaign execution.

product.name: Industry-Specific AI SDR Agents
product.description: Pre-trained AI sales agents tailored to specific industries to execute targeted outbound campaigns using relevant data sources and industry signals.

product.name: CRM and Communication Integrations
product.description: Integrations with CRM systems and communication platforms to synchronize data, train AI agents, and provide real-time feedback during outbound campaigns.
